name: @bit-ark/dsh-work
description: Right-docked workbench panel with multi-instance tab system: file/dir tree, git operations, sandboxed browser with Eruda devtools, interactive multi-terminal (node-pty + xterm.js over WebSocket), and a task board (Host-authoritative ledger, real DSH session execution, Host cron scheduling), plus extensible feature registry. Features open as tabs from a grid home, multiple instances supported.

scripts.test: node build.mjs && node test/classify.test.mjs && node test/preview.test.mjs && node test/panel.test.mjs && node test/terminal.test.mjs && node test/taskboard.test.mjs && node test/host.test.mjs
